evidence_quotes:
If you are running this test because the engine is hard to start when cold, remember that
there is also a cold start advance circuit (part of the fuel system) which is not checked
here.

here.
statements.reason: Both Glowplugs Circuit Tests passages say the other cold-start advance circuit is not checked there.
statements.statement: The secondary cold-start circuit is excluded from the Glowplugs Circuit Tests.

statements.reason: The supplied Fuel System passage describes approximately 3 to 5 degrees of advance during cold startup; it does not instruct setting the timing advance to 0 degrees for the check.
statements.statement: When checking the secondary cold-start circuit under the Fuel System guidance in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, the timing advance should be set to 0 degrees.

statements.reason: The supplied guidance specifies an engine temperature below 90°F (32°C) for checking advance circuit operation, not ambient temperature.
statements.statement: When checking the secondary cold-start circuit under the Fuel System guidance in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, the engine temperature should be at ambient temperature (cold).
